detail.longDescription: Since 18 Nov 2026, development of the game # Spiderball has been discontinued. It was also decided to wind up the Palace4Software IG (only the IG is being wound up, so don't worry, # Palace4Software is still going strong!). It has also been decided that the # P4STEngine will be completely rewritten – no longer in # Python , but in C++. Further information can be found here: https:// palace4software.eu/story/#%F0% 9F%91%91%202026:%20A%20Crown%20for%20a%20Palace # cpp # LibreSoftware # FreeSoftware # FLOSS # programming # GNU # Linux # GNUlinux # indiedev
